title: Talab va taklifning bozor kuchlari
englishTitle: The Market Forces of Supply and Demand
lead: Bozor narxlari xaridorlar va sotuvchilarning qarorlarini muvofiqlashtiradi. Talab va taklif egri chiziqlarini o‘qib, muvozanat qanday shakllanishi va hodisalar uni qanday o‘zgartirishini o‘rganamiz.

sections.title: Xaridorlar qancha sotib olmoqchi?

topicCoverage: Case Study: Two Ways to Reduce Smoking
qualityChecks: All 9 review questions, 11 applications and 13 QuickQuiz questions checked against the source; all 23 lettered application subparts are covered.
QuickQuiz 5 now asks about hamburger price increasing pizza demand; QuickQuiz 6 now asks about income increasing and inferior pasta demand.
Application 4(c) uses the lower TV price to explain increased streaming demand and decreased cinema demand; it no longer attributes the latter to a higher streaming price.
Application 7 separates movements along hot-dog demand from ketchup and input demand shifts; orange juice result is conditional on substitution.
Application 10(b) evaluates a rise in flour price versus a rise in milk price, matching the source wording.
All six pizza schedule points plotted on both curves; exact common point Q=81, P=6.
All five old and expanded basketball demand points plotted; fixed supply Q=8000 intersects at P=8 and P=12 respectively.
Orange demand and supply both increase: quantity rises; diagrams show price increasing, unchanged and decreasing.
Cigarette figures preserve source points (20,5), (10,5) and (12,10); historical 10%,4%,12% statements distinguish estimates from illustrative figure points.
HTML stack is balanced and local fragment parsing finds exactly 10 direct sibling sections; malformed bold tag and missing opening paragraph repaired.
All 30 SVGs parse as XML and have title/description; IDs are unique and begin c4-.
No Cyrillic, Armenian or Georgian characters remain; source statistics remain labeled historical.
